mapper.sql: p.id, p.purchase_no, p.book_name, p.author, p.isbn, p.publisher, p.category_id, p.quantity, p.unit_price, p.total_price, p.applicant_id, p.applicant_name, p.app_id, p.integration_form_id, p.status, p.expected_date, p.remark, p.submit_time, p.stock_in_time, p.cancel_time, p.stock_in_book_id, p.stock_in_remark, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.is_deleted, c.category_name AS category_name, a.app_name AS app_name, f.status AS form_status
pf.current_node AS current_node, pf.node_status AS node_status
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM book_purchase p LEFT JOIN book_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN integration_app a ON p.app_id = a.id LEFT JOIN integration_form f ON p.integration_form_id = f.id LEFT JOIN purchase_flow pf ON pf.purchase_id = p.id AND pf.is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM book_purchase p LEFT JOIN book_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN integration_app a ON p.app_id = a.id LEFT JOIN integration_form f ON p.integration_form_id = f.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_purchase (purchase_no, book_name, author, isbn, publisher, category_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, applicant_id, applicant_name, status, expected_date, remark) VALUES (#{purchaseNo}, #{bookName}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{publisher}, #{categoryId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{status}, #{expectedDate}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE book_purchase SET book_name = #{bookName}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, publisher = #{publisher}, category_id = #{categoryId}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, expected_date = #{expectedDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0
UPDATE book_purchase SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE book_purchase SET status = 1, app_id = #{appId}, integration_form_id = #{formId}, submit_time = #{submitTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0
UPDATE book_purchase SET status = 3 WHERE integration_form_id = #{formId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE book_purchase SET status = 2, stock_in_time = #{stockInTime}, stock_in_book_id = #{bookId}, stock_in_remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 3)
UPDATE book_purchase SET status = 9, cancel_time = #{cancelTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE book_purchase SET app_id = #{appId}, integration_form_id = #{formId}, submit_time = #{submitTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE book_purchase SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 3
UPDATE book_purchase SET status = 2, stock_in_time = #{stockInTime}, stock_in_book_id = #{bookId}, stock_in_remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 3)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM book_purchase p LEFT JOIN book_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN integration_app a ON p.app_id = a.id LEFT JOIN integration_form f ON p.integration_form_id = f.id WHERE p.integration_form_id = #{formId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id FROM book_purchase p INNER JOIN purchase_flow pf ON pf.purchase_id = p.id AND pf.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND pf.current_node = 'SUPER' AND pf.node_status = 0 AND pf.erp_submit_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pf.erp_submit_time ASC
